content.value: Water flows at a steady mean velocity of 1.5 m/sec through a 50 mm diameter pipe sloping upwards at 40° to the horizontal. At a section some distancé,downstream of the inlet, the pressure is 650 kPa and at a suction 30 m further along the pipe, the pressure is 450 kPa. Determine the average shear stress at the wall of the pipe and at a radius of 10 mm.
